name: HypoSpace
description: Many scientific problems are underdetermined: multiple distinct hypotheses are equally consistent with the same observations. In such settings, effective inference requires not only producing valid explanations, but also systematically exploring and covering the admissible hypothesis set. We introduce HypoSpace, a benchmark that treats large language models (LLMs) as samplers over finite hypothesis spaces and evaluates them on three metrics: Validity, Uniqueness, and Recovery.
